description: Agent Roles: submit a role’s ownership with its records: the role with its id, title, when it last changed hands or was rewritten and its description as written, whose first line is read for the owner; the owner with the name, kind (a person, a team, an agent or a placeholder), whether the description names them at the top, the decisions they hold over the role (scope, permissions, delegation, handoff and retirement), when they took the role, when they last confirmed it and whether they are still in post; the backup or successor with the name and kind; and the date ownership is read at. The signed report gives the owner with the kind read, placeholder names such as the team read as placeholders, the first line of the description, the decisions held and lacking, the backup with whether it is a different person, and the currency of ownership against the date the role last changed hands, and counts them, and names a missing owner: no owner, an owner who is a team, an agent or a placeholder, an owner not named at the top, an owner no longer in post, an owner holding no decision over the role’s scope or permissions and ownership carried over from before the role last changed hands; then no backup, a backup who is the owner or not a person, decisions the owner lacks and a confirmation over a year old, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. An unstated kind, top line, authority, assignment date, change date or post status leaves ownership unverified. This reads one role’s ownership: a production agent’s named owner, responder and fallback are wever_incident-ownership-check, the accountable person for each outcome is wever_ownership-map-brief and whether a registry entry names an owner is wever_agent-registry-check. Verdict role_owner_missing, role_owner_partial, role_owner_unverified or role_owner_named. POST /api/role-owner-check. Reads the role records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Roles reads a role’s own records and checks the role itself: what the job is, who owns it, whether the permissions the agent holds match the written role, where its scope ends, whether a change of holder rewrote the description, whether it is reviewed on schedule, whether duties stay apart across the roles one agent holds, and whether delegations stay inside what the role allows. Beside it, wever_onboarding-permissions-check and wever_onboarding-readiness-check read a new agent’s grants and written job at joining, while a role check reads the written role and its records at any time after; wever_authority-scope-check reads one action’s access against its authority grant, while the permission match check reads every permission held against the role; and the Agent Delegation checks such as wever_delegation-scope-check read one delegation on its own terms, while the delegation check reads every delegation against what the role allows. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-roles-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-roles/.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

active.description: Whether the owner is still in post.

assigned_at.description: When the owner took the role, such as 2026-11-20.

at_top.description: Whether the description names the owner at the top.

authority.description: What the owner decides for the role.

confirmed_at.description: When the owner last confirmed it, such as 2026-11-20.

read_at.description: The date ownership is read at, such as 2026-11-20.

changed_at.description: When the role last changed hands or was rewritten, such as 2026-11-20.

text.description: The description as written; its first line is read for the owner.

name: wever_role-owner-check
title: Role owner check
